# Blockly

[Blockly](https://github.com/google/blockly) 11.2.2, © Google LLC, Apache License 2.0 (file `LICENSE`).

Taken unchanged from the npm package `blockly@11.2.2`: `blockly_compressed.js`, `blocks_compressed.js`,
`msg/vi.js` and the pictures in `media/` (the sound files are left out; the editor runs with sounds off).

Kept in the repository so that `blocks.html` works from a folder without a network connection, like the
other pages in `docs/play`. `src/port/web/build.py` copies this folder to `docs/play/vendor/`.
